name: Tampa Metal Works Inc

At Tampa Metal Works, we take pride in supporting local businesses. That’s what we work with trusted partners to ensure you receive the quality you deserve.
about:
Tampa Metal Works Inc operates from Tampa, Florida, where it has provided metal fabrication and installation services across the state for nearly 40 years. The company is locally owned and operated, though no founding year or founder names are disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication, including in-house manufacturing of scuppers, downspouts, handrails, chimney caps, and collector boxes using brake metal and flat stock. It also performs field welding and on-site installation, and offers prompt delivery services. The facility warehouses a broad inventory of flat stock to support quick turnaround.

Primary customers are commercial contractors in the roofing, sheet metal, and construction trades. The company serves projects throughout Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Polk, Manatee, Hardee, Highlands, Sarasota, and DeSoto counties, with nationwide shipping available.

Tampa Metal Works emphasizes its understanding of contractor challenges, citing durable results, fast turnaround from stocked inventory, and reliable delivery as key differentiators. It holds a Florida roofing contractor license (CCC1329561) and follows SMACNA standards, with memberships in FRSA and NRCA.
